A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same TIDE research paper. Complete main text, equations, tables, figures and Appendix A are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original depth-estimation and semantic-segmentation experiments, component and data-scaling ablations, and qualitative generation results in Tables 2–6 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the quantitative evaluations, ablations and appendix demonstrations.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.5 retain the same TIDE architecture, Implicit Layout Sharing, Time Adaptive Normalization, training objective and data-synthesis procedure.

E1.justification: Training datasets, SynTIDE synthesis, Sea-thru/SQUID depth evaluations and UIIS/USIS10K segmentation evaluations are unchanged. Challenging-condition and appendix zero-shot scenarios are also retained.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same Atlantis comparisons across four depth models. Table 3 retains the same real-data and SynTIDE comparisons for SegFormer, Mask2Former and ViT-Adapter.

E3.justification: Table 1 and Sections 5.1–5.4 specify identical splits, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, training budgets and evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: Component, component-position and data-scaling ablations in Tables 4–6 are unchanged. Figures 5–6 and Appendix A retain the same challenging-condition, diversity, qualitative-comparison and zero-shot analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 2–6 contain identical numerical results, and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, SynTIDE-trained NewCRFs retains Sea-thru SIlog 22.37 and delta1 0.84 in Table 2.

T1.justification: The diffusion preliminaries and mathematical formulations in Equations 1–7 are identical. No definitions, assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about text-only joint image/dense-annotation generation, ILS/TAN contributions and benefits for underwater prediction.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, interpretations of the experiments and generalization discussion are unchanged. Section 5.6 retains the same limitations concerning instance-level masks and challenging underwater imagery.

D1.justification: Data preparation, implementation settings, LoRA ranks, GPU information and code-access statement are identical. The new funding acknowledgement supplies no additional technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 44 references are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to Atlantis and prior single-task data-synthesis methods.

P1.justification: v2 adds an acknowledgement of NSFC grants U2341227 and 62225603 after the conclusion and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section organization are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Page 8 has small spacing and positioning adjustments around Figure 6, the limitations and conclusion to accommodate the acknowledgement. Figure/table contents, captions and appendix displays remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding attribution and makes small presentation adjustments. Scientific content, experimental evidence, limitations and reproducibility information remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, so these administrative edits do not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
